[[Inscription Stone]]s are found in [[Sparkfly Swamp]] during the quest [[Finding Gadd]] and in [[Finding the Bloodstone]]. During Finding the Bloodstone, when you kill an [[Inscribed Ettin]], you return the inscription from the ettin to the Inscription Stone in order to access the next level of the cave.
